Parallel ray → far focus; central ray → straight; near-focus ray → parallel. \(m=h_{\mathrm i}/h_{\mathrm o}=-d_{\mathrm i}/d_{\mathrm o}\). Negative \(m\): inverted. \(d_{\mathrm o}=f\): no finite image plane.
\(I=P/(4\pi r^2)\) / W m⁻². Steady isotropic small source, \(r>0\), negligible losses. Small perpendicular collector: \(P_{\mathrm{received}}=IA\), \(E=IA\Delta t\) for steady intensity.

Resolution: distinguish nearby features. Magnification: image/display size. Cadence: time between samples. Exposure: accumulation interval. Finer sampling cannot undo optical blur or exposure averaging.
